name: Dream Cradle of the Dark Tapestry
piloting: Arcana (DC 30), Religion (DC 32), Occultism (DC 30), or Piloting Lore (DC 29)

items.name: Burst
items.text: When the dream cradle is destroyed, the egg-balloon shatters, releasing a cloud of nightmarish oneiric energy. Creatures other than the pilot and passengers within 30 feet of the dream cradle take 14d6 mental damage (DC 32 basic Will save save). On a failed save, the creature is also Frightened 2 (Frightened 4 and Fleeing for 1 round on a critical failure). The dream cradle then uses that last of its magical reserves to cast Fly on the pilot and each passenger.

items.name: Recharge
items.text: Each day, the dream cradle can be used for up to 1 hour before it shrinks back into its egg form to recharge for 8 hours. One minute before it shrinks, the balloon wobbles in warning, giving the pilot time to land.

items.name: Vertical Travel
items.text: The dream cradle's Speed doubles while moving straight up or down

text: Long ago, Yig revealed that some of his sekmin children slept deep beneath the Kodar Mountains. In response, his surface-dwelling worshippers developed this item to navigate the Darklands' vast chasms in search of the Great Old One's lost progeny. When the dream cradle of the Dark Tapestry is activated as a single action with the concentrate trait, over the course of 1 minute, the fist-sized egg expands to the size of a hot-air balloon, to which a basket or other platform can be attached.
